Show what the registry knows about this plugin's versions

Usage: hpy registry plugin status [OPTIONS] [VERSION]

Arguments:
  [VERSION]  A single version to inspect

Options:
      --json         Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --name <NAME>  Project name (default: hpy.toml [project] name, then manifest.json id)
      --no-input     Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible actions still need
                     --yes. Implied without a terminal
  -C <DIR>           Run as if started in DIR
  -h, --help         Print help
